description: Stage-two JTT objective for multiclass classification: weight each per-example cross-entropy by lambda_up when a caller-supplied fixed mask marks it as an error from the stage-one identification model; the mask is defined in Just Train Twice §4, Eq. (7), and the weighted objective in §4, Eq. (8).

examples.title: Train a classifier with the JTT stage-two objective

name: Just Train Twice stage-two weighted loss

parameters.error_mask: required fixed boolean or binary numeric tensor with shape [B], true for examples misclassified by the stage-one identification model
parameters.ignore_index: optional integer class index to exclude from the loss and mean divisor (default None)
parameters.lambda_up: positive finite real weight for error_mask examples (default 1.0; lambda_up=1 recovers ERM per Just Train Twice §4)
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point multiclass logits with shape [B, C]
parameters.reduction: none per example, mean over valid examples, or sum (default mean)
parameters.targets: class indices with shape [B]; long tensors or integral-valued numeric tensors are accepted
